summary: The URL https://poki.com/ is the official domain for Poki, a popular and legitimate online gaming platform. No phishing, brand impersonation, or malicious indicators were detected.

The URL attempts to impersonate the legitimate FitGirl Repacks website, which is a well-known video game repacking group. The official site is typically hosted on a different domain (.cc), making this domain a likely typosquatting or mirror site used to distribute cracked software, potentially bundled with malware or adware.
